status.totalsOnlyHint: Traffic per app is not measured: {reason}
status.noConnection: Error: the monitor does not answer. {detail}
status.demoHint: This page runs in a browser, so it shows a made-up computer.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: All traffic of this PC, as it happens.
overview.chartLabel: Download and upload speed of this PC over the last five minutes
overview.quiet: Nothing is using the network right now.
overview.perAppTitle: Traffic per app needs administrator rights
overview.perAppBody: netSwitch sees the totals of your network adapters and the open connections, but not how much each app sends and receives. Start netSwitch as administrator.
overview.notWindowsBody: It reads traffic from Windows itself and changes Windows Firewall rules, so on this system there is nothing to show.

apps.title: Apps
apps.subtitle: Every app that used the network since netSwitch started. Switch one off to block its internet.
apps.protectedHint: netSwitch does not block programs in the Windows folder: one of them, such as svchost.exe, can carry the whole PC's traffic.
apps.noPath: Windows does not say which program this is, so it cannot be blocked.
apps.empty: No app has used the network yet.
apps.emptyOnline: No app is sending or receiving right now.
apps.blockBody: netSwitch adds two Windows Firewall rules, inbound and outbound, for {path}. The app keeps running, without internet. Switch it on again here or on the Blocked page.

connections.title: Connections
connections.subtitle: Who each app talks to. Names come from the app's own DNS lookups, else from reverse DNS.
connections.searchPlaceholder: Search app, host, address or port

blocked.title: Blocked apps
blocked.subtitle: netSwitch, AppIntBlocker and its window share these Windows Firewall rules. Unblocking here gives the app its internet back everywhere.
blocked.incompleteHint: A program here has only an inbound or only an outbound rule.
blocked.unblockBody: netSwitch removes its {count} firewall rules, and {name} gets its internet access back.
blocked.unblockAllBody: netSwitch removes every rule named "AppBlocker Rule", {count} in all, also the ones AppIntBlocker added.
blocked.restoreHint: To restore a backup, run netsh advfirewall import with its path as administrator. It replaces all current rules.
blocked.emptyHint: Switch an app off on the Apps page and it shows up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notifyNewApps: Tell me when an app goes online for the first time
settings.notifyNewAppsHint: Once per app each time netSwitch runs.
settings.dailyBackup: Back up the firewall before the first change of each day
settings.aboutBody: netSwitch shows which apps use your network and blocks the ones you switch off with Windows Firewall rules.

notify.title: {name} went online
notify.body: Its first connection to the internet since netSwitch started.

errors.firewall_failed: Error: Windows Firewall did not accept the change. {detail}
errors.protected_program: Error: {detail} is part of Windows, and blocking it could cut off the whole PC.
errors.unsupported: Error: netSwitch changes the firewall on Windows only.
errors.no_documents_folder: Error: the Documents folder could not be found.
errors.settings_not_saved: Error: the settings were not saved. {detail}
